wireframe_source: Blender actual source object meshes; Wireframe modifier on same mesh data, not reconstruction

inspection_exceptions.boundary_edges: Expected on intentionally open discs, panels, and mechanical assemblies; inspect per named mesh
inspection_exceptions.multi_mesh_coplanar_assembly: not automatically welded across different objects, to preserve hierarchy and movable parts
inspection_exceptions.remaining_duplicate_vertex_candidates: count includes intentional UV/sharp-separated and identical coordinates of separate loops, no automatic merge
